mechanism_hypothesis: 动作监督把‘必须执行修复、HOLD非法’的状态也作为 execute-vs-HOLD 训练标签，损失可能由不可选择的反事实主导。

domain_filter.name: feasible_action_states
domain_filter.routing: net_value routing without the old classifier large-transition rule
domain_filter.not_allowed: no risk cap, no threshold, no new parameter changes

empirical_check_existing_rows.note: empirical only; does not pre-judge harm. Infeasible rows have lower label variance.

experiment_design.evaluation: 10bp own-path annual training; primary cost book owns its own label fee
experiment_design.post_freeze: 2023+ repeated diagnostic (reused history), not clean holdout
experiment_design.stress: 10/25bp reuse the corresponding annual frozen models
experiment_design.control: all-state training on the same frozen coherent input
experiment_design.warmup_fallback: insufficient feasible rows -> original execute-target fallback; report annual feasible training counts

data.vintage: single current QFQ vintage; hash frozen before training
data.source_vintage_note: if source-vintage differences are not isolated, label as different-vintage diagnostic, not pure price effect

isolation_rules: candidate and all-state control use the same frozen coherent input
filter effect must not be mixed with data or fee mechanism
source original saved annual models used only as external anchor; no refit passed off as frozen
DatasetH/scaler fit only past matured legal training rows; causal own-state rolling; no future results used for earlier fits
pure training filter=all must exactly reproduce the existing control
negative_tests: illegal HOLD rows future-label perturbation does not change the feasible-fit
legal future-year label perturbation does not change past fit
two-domain statistics do not filter by future results
sealed_boundary: new thin wrapper parameterizes domain; sealed E module (stage1_economic_training.py) unchanged
stopping_rule: if this candidate fails, stop this mechanism; do not chase minrows/penalty/threshold. Historical pass only freezes for independent forward; no auto SIM switch.
reporting: explicitly report active/no_hold/SOXX; do not claim stable excess unless above gross SOXX
